name: event-keynote-schedule
title: Event Keynote Schedule
description: A multi-track developer conference agenda with speaker profiles, track tags, and calendar reminders.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Brutalist
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Event Keynote Schedule Interaction: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
